profile_text.body:
Digital Realty Trust, Inc., which also goes by Digital Realty, is a public company headquartered in Austin, Texas, and traded under the ticker DLR. Its website describes a global data center platform offering colocation, interconnection, connectivity, and cloud services, spanning single racks to private suites and high-density AI workflows. The company says its platform is built for flexibility, open ecosystems, and reach.

On AI, the site frames infrastructure as the pressure point, saying inference loads and GPU demands are pushing traditional environments to their limits. It cites its 2026 Global Data Insights Survey, reporting that 40% of IT leaders cite infrastructure as an AI constraint, and describes enterprises moving from AI strategy to execution.

The site's own record lists no AI products and no lawsuits involving the company. It records a law exposure count of 126 in Texas.
